subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should OpenClaw implement a first-class Control UI channel view toggle here, or fold the channel-separated and merged-timeline semantics into the broader sessions workspace design at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901?
rationale: Current main has enough channel metadata to make the feature plausible, but the requested toggle changes Control UI UX, session-state boundaries, and cross-channel transcript visibility.

options.title: Keep this as canonical channel view
options.body: Use this issue to define channel-separated tabs and merged timeline semantics, while linking broader workspace work as a sibling design input.

options.title: Fold into sessions workspace
options.body: Move the remaining behavior into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 and close this only after that issue explicitly owns the channel toggle semantics.

options.title: Limit to sidebar grouping
options.body: Accept only lightweight channel grouping such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89044 for now and defer merged timeline work.

recommendation.title: Keep this as canonical channel view
recommendation.body: Use this issue to define channel-separated tabs and merged timeline semantics, while linking broader workspace work as a sibling design input.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily Control UI/UX shape, and CONTRIBUTING.md lists @BunsDev for UI/UX ownership with relevant Control UI history.
